summary_paragraph: The patient was directly admitted from bariatric surgery clinic for recurrent severe abdominal pain with nausea, felt most consistent with gastritis. She was treated with IV pain control transitioned successfully to oral pain medication and started on high-dose IV pantoprazole with symptomatic improvement. Diet and gastrostomy tube feeds were restarted overnight into hospital day 2. A PICC line was placed on hospital day 2 to allow continuation of IV pantoprazole at home, with chest X-ray confirming appropriate catheter tip position in the distal SVC and no acute cardiopulmonary findings. She was discharged home with services on pantoprazole 40 mg IV every 12 hours via PICC and continuation of her home medications, with surgical follow-up arranged.
